    groups=[]

            groups.append((c,rs[0]))
    # distinct occupied column centers, with their row-derived colors
    centers=[]

        while j+1<len(groups) and groups[j+1][0]==groups[j][0]+1: j+=1

        # nearest object center; ties favor middle object
